description: Let Mara attempt the real Dam ladder, preserve bodily injury, support rescue/promise actions, keep exact entrusted-rope custody visible and truthful through ordinary GIVE, and defer quoted actor continuation to canonical Zork V-TELL routing.

replacements.old:
(<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA-FIELD-ROPE>
                  <TELL "Mara's rope is waxed against water, marked at measured intervals, and coiled for use rather than decoration." CR>)
replacements.new:
(<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA-FIELD-ROPE>
                  <TELL "Mara's rope is waxed against water, marked at measured intervals, and coiled for use rather than decoration.">
                  <COND (<IN? ,MARA-FIELD-ROPE ,ADVENTURER>
                         <TELL " The wet measured coil is currently in your hands under Mara's explicit temporary custody." CR>)
                        (<IN? ,MARA-FIELD-ROPE ,MARA>
                         <TELL " Mara has the measured coil in her own custody." CR>)
                        (T
                         <TELL " Its physical location, not a relationship flag, determines who has it." CR>)>)

replacements.old:
(<VERB? TAKE GIVE MOVE MUNG>
           <TELL "Mara keeps custody of her own field equipment. Ask for help with a real task rather than treating her as an equipment locker." CR>
           <RTRUE>)>
replacements.new:
(<AND <VERB? GIVE>
                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA-FIELD-ROPE>
                <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,MARA>>
           <MARA-RETURN-ENTRUSTED-ROPE>)
          (<VERB? TAKE GIVE MOVE MUNG>
           <TELL "Mara keeps custody of her own field equipment. Ask for help with a real task rather than treating her as an equipment locker." CR>
           <RTRUE>)>

replacements.old:
<COND (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-DEATH-WITNESSED>
                  <TELL " Since seeing you die, she watches your footing with an attention that is no longer merely professional.">)>
replacements.new:
<COND (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-LADDER-INJURY>
                  <TELL " One palm is scraped raw from the Dam ladder, and she is protecting a shoulder that stiffened under the catch.">)>
           <COND (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-DEATH-WITNESSED>
                  <TELL " Since seeing you die, she watches your footing with an attention that is no longer merely professional.">)>

replacements.old:
(<AND <VERB? GIVE> <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,MARA>>
           <TELL "Mara does not accept permanent custody merely because an object was offered. SHOW it to her if the point is evidence; keep it if the point is ownership." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
replacements.new:
(<AND <VERB? GIVE>
                <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,MARA>
                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA-FIELD-ROPE>>
           <MARA-RETURN-ENTRUSTED-ROPE>)
          (<AND <VERB? GIVE> <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,MARA>>
           <TELL "Mara does not accept permanent custody merely because an object was offered. SHOW it to her if the point is evidence; keep it if the point is ownership." CR>
           <RTRUE>)

replacements.old:
(<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? HELLO>>
           <TELL "Mara gives you a small nod. Hello, she says. Still here." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? TAKE>>
           <MARA-TAKE-REFUSAL>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? PUSH MOVE DROP THROW PUT PUT-ON>>
           <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
replacements.new:
(<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? MARA-RESCUE>>
           <V-MARA-RESCUE>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? MARA-PROMISE>>
           <V-MARA-PROMISE>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA>
                <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-LADDER-PERIL>
                <VERB? TAKE PUSH MOVE>>
           <V-MARA-RESCUE>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? HELLO>>
           <TELL "Mara gives you a small nod. Hello, she says. Still here." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? TAKE>>
           <MARA-TAKE-REFUSAL>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? PUSH MOVE DROP THROW PUT PUT-ON>>
           <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
